Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay Hon'Ble Mr. Justice
Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
--------
For the Appellant : Mrs. Nalini Jha, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shashi Kumar Verma, App
--------

th Order No. 07/ Dated: 05 January, 2026 I.A. No. 17014 of 2025 Heard Mrs. Nalini Jha, learned counsel for the appellant and learned APP.
2.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him, during the pendency of this appeal.

3. The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Sections 363, 376, 302 and 201 of the IPC and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of his natural life along with a fine of Rs. 20,000/- for the offence under Section 376 of the IPC.
4. It has been alleged that the niece of the informant was playing in the field and when she did not return home, the matter was informed to the police.
It was suspected that some unknown accused had kidnapped the niece of the informant.

5. Though, it has been submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in custody since 12.01.2015 but regard being had to the involvement of the appellant in committing the rape and murder of eight year old niece of the informant which also find support from the post-mortem Budhdeo Bahadur vs The State Of Jharkhand on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128499370/
1 report, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail and his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.

sentences.text: 6. However, considering the period of custody undergone by the appellant, we are inclined to hear this appeal on merits.

Accordingly, let this matter be listed under the heading "For Final Hearing"
on 10 th February, 2026.
7.
Office, in the meantime, is directed to prepare the paper book.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) 05.01.2026 Basant Uploaded on 06/01/2026 Budhdeo Bahadur vs The State Of Jharkhand on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128499370/
